_comment: Phase 1 dialogue move catalog (gdd-npc-dialogue.md §5.2). Six moves ONLY. This JSON is the action-vocabulary registration site for dialogue moves (the formal action_vocabulary.gd does not yet exist per conventions §10.1; moves are data-defined per §5.1). DialogueMoveCatalog loads and gates these. Phase 2/3 moves (ask_question, offer_*, request_action, quest_*, persuade_ruler, use_ability, army-parley) are intentionally absent.

moves.label: Converse
moves.notes: Small talk; no roll. Feeds memory; may surface knowledge marked freely (Phase 2+).

moves.label: Ask for Rumor
moves.notes: Phase 1 uses a STUB rumor pool (no live quest/rumor system yet, Wave 0 sequencing). Requires attitude >= Neutral (§5.2).

moves.label: Intimidate
moves.notes: Intimidation tone (ax_reactions:151-241); Fearful/Cowed substitutions. Result 2 -> combat.

moves.label: Seduce
moves.notes: Seduction tone (ax_reactions:243-324); NPC must be flagged receptive.

moves.label: Provoke
moves.notes: No roll to anger: attitude shifts 1 step toward Hostile per use (PROJECT CALL). On reaching Hostile, NPC attacks immediately (acore_adventures:952-954).
